title: 品格教育：感恩
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Gratitude 品格教育：感恩

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.en: the year your school was born
strip.zh: 你們學校誕生的那一年

strip.en: years of people who cared for it
strip.zh: 年來照顧這所學校的人

strip.en: thank-you card from each of you

lines.en: Today I came up the mountain to meet you.
lines.zh: 今天我上山來認識你們。

slides.ask_en: Before 1:30 today, who did something for you?
slides.ask_zh: 今天下午一點半以前，有誰為你做了什麼？

slides.body_en: Gratitude means noticing what other people do for you — and then saying thank you, or giving something back.
slides.body_zh: 感恩，就是注意到別人為你做了什麼——然後說聲謝謝，或是回饋一點什麼。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone made breakfast for you today.
prompts.zh: 今天有人幫你準備早餐的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if someone brought you up the hill to school.
prompts.zh: 今天有人送你上山來學校的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you said thank you to them.
prompts.zh: 而且有跟他們說謝謝的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: So many people help us every day. We just don't always notice.
slides.punch_zh: 每天有好多人在幫我們，只是我們不一定注意到。

slides.q_en: Riddle: I start work before you wake up. I cook lunch for the whole school. Who am I?
slides.q_zh: 猜猜我是誰：你還沒起床我就開始工作，我為全校煮午餐。
slides.explain_en: A school cook! Next time you eat lunch, think about whose hands made it.
slides.explain_zh: 午餐廚工！下次吃午餐時，想想是誰的手做出來的。

slides.head_en: A School Built by 100 Years of Hands
slides.head_zh: 一百年的手，蓋起這所學校
slides.body_en: Siling Elementary was born in 1923. Every classroom, every tree and every team is here because someone before you cared.
slides.body_zh: 西嶺國小創校於 1923 年。每一間教室、每一棵樹、每一支校隊，都是因為在你之前有人用心。

slides.q_en: Your English lessons, clubs and after-school care are free. Who pays for them?
slides.q_zh: 你們的英語課、社團和課後照顧都免費。是誰出的錢？
slides.explain_en: Your alumni! Long ago they sat in your seats. Now they give back so you can learn.
slides.explain_zh: 是校友！很久以前他們就坐在你的位子上，現在回來幫助你們學習。

slides.head_en: Who Taught the Lion to Dance?
slides.body_en: Your lion-dance team began in 2016 — but the dance is about 100 years old. Local masters passed it on, step by step.
slides.body_zh: 你們的舞獅隊 2016 年成立——但這套獅藝大約有一百年了，是在地的師傅一步一步傳下來的。

slides.q_en: Siling has something no other elementary school in Taiwan has. What is it?
slides.q_zh: 西嶺有一樣東西，是全台灣其他國小都沒有的。是什麼？
slides.explain_en: A kite museum, opened in 2002! Teachers and students before you built it, kite by kite.
slides.explain_zh: 風箏館，2002 年啟用！是你們之前的老師和學長姐，一只一只風箏做出來的。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: You only need to say thank you for big things.
items.zh: 只有大事才需要說謝謝。
items.note_en: Small things count too — like holding a door.
items.note_zh: 小事也算——像是幫你扶門。

items.en: Saying thank you can make YOU happier, too.
items.zh: 說謝謝也會讓自己更快樂。
items.note_en: Scientists have studied it: grateful people often feel happier.
items.note_zh: 科學家研究過：懂得感恩的人通常比較快樂。

items.note_en: Your alumni showed it with actions. So can you.
items.note_zh: 你們的校友用行動表現。你也可以。

items.en: Saying thank you takes a lot of time.
items.note_zh: 五秒鐘就夠了。今天就試試看！

items.zh: 我真的很感謝你的幫忙。

items.en: We couldn't do it without you.

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many helpers as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「幫助我們的人」越好，我來數！

slides.prompt_en: Who is one person at Siling you want to thank?
slides.prompt_zh: 在西嶺，你最想感謝的一個人是誰？
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.tip_en: Give it to them yourself — today!

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me: who will get YOUR card?
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我：你的卡片要送給誰？

slides.head_zh: 今天就可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Say thank you to a helper — and use their name.
items.zh: 向一位幫助你的人說謝謝——叫出他的名字。

items.en: Give your card to the person you wrote it for.
items.zh: 把卡片親手交給你寫給的那個人。

items.en: Help a younger student. One day, YOU will be the alumni.
items.zh: 幫學弟妹一個忙。有一天，你也會是校友。

slides.q_en: Dom's neighbors in California say “gracias” every day. Which language is it?
slides.q_zh: Dom 在加州的鄰居每天都說「gracias」。那是哪一種語言？
slides.explain_en: Spanish! Merci is French, danke is German, and arigatō is Japanese.
slides.explain_zh: 西班牙文！Merci 是法文，danke 是德文，arigatō 是日文。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Siling Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell Dom who you thanked today.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到西嶺國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴 Dom 你今天感謝了誰。

slides.big_en:
Every school is built
by many hands.
slides.big_zh: 每一所學校，都是很多雙手一起蓋起來的。
